result.title: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
result.summary: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OmniHarness-RSI，一个面向全模态理解的无参数更新 agent harness 演化框架：将演化空间分解为模态路由协作、模态感知证据定位与模态特定感知三维度，构建含感知专家与音视频检索工具的 agent，并通过模态-能力归因、代码交互修改与验证引导选择来迭代改进 harness。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「模态感知证据定位」与按能力归因诊断缺陷的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 决策提供可核查借鉴；报告称演化后减少 planner 调用与查看帧数，或与 STOP 及动态计算成本相关，但未涉及内部 latent 状态表示。
